subject: maths
question: If a man walks at five-sixth of his usual speed from his home towards his office, he is 20 minutes late. Find the usual time (in minutes) to cover the distance between his home and his office.
solution:
**Given:**

If a man walks at five-sixth of his usual speed from his home towards his office, he is 20 minutes late.

**Formula used:**

Let the usual time be T minutes. If the speed is reduced to five-sixth, the time taken will be dfrac{6}{5}T .

Difference in time = dfrac{6}{5}T - T = 20 minutes

**Calculations:**

dfrac{6}{5}T - T = 20

⇒ dfrac{6T - 5T}{5} = 20

⇒ dfrac{T}{5} = 20

⇒ T = 20 × 5

⇒ T = 100 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
